items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: The leader at the Rice Hotel, I knew him very well, his name was Finley.

ctx.x: Yes, sir. They used to send out the orchestrations with two pieces, just like you say, a platter, with the flaps, what do you call it, the flap? What's the side they don't expect? The flip side. The flip side. They give you two pieces, one orchestration. So I put that on there. So if I went big, and I always went big, not to brag, I'd get up and I'd give them those three-fifths notes, and we'd go into it, knock them stiff. Easy. Easy. But maybe luck. Maybe just do good judgment. Maybe some inborn experience. I…
